note: Ground-floor quantities room (2): proportions, majorities and mixtures, kept by animal shopkeepers. Most nouns here are feminine, so the divider sits at x=950: feminine nouns to the left of it, the three masculine ones (aspect, mélange, pan) to the right. The left door goes back to the first quantities room; the right door leads on to the third quantities room.
